basis: Frozen before implementation (D4, D7). Observations are the pinned seed interpreter output recorded by regen.py; cases hold reviewed literals. Nothing is derived from Knot.

commands.wrapper: import <fixture, relative to the wrapper> as F; def main() -> F.<result>: F.<entry>(F.<arg>{}, ...)

requirements.agree: Knot checks the fixture (exit 0), and for every call in observations its evaluator and its emitted Wasm return the recorded result tag.
requirements.agree-or-unsupported: Either agree, or exit 3 with an Unsupported diagnostic and no artifact. Invalid (exit 2) is never acceptable: the seed accepts.
requirements.unsupported: Exit 3; stderr starts with the pinned diagnostic; no artifact is written.
requirements.reject: Never Checked or Built; no artifact is written. With exit pinned, only that outcome class qualifies; with diagnostic pinned, stderr starts with it. Otherwise exit 2 or 3.

cases.name: box-unbox
cases.intent: One erased type parameter, one instantiation, one generic match.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 6; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: box-instances
cases.intent: unbox instantiated at Flag, Color and Box<A>; unbox2 forwards its own type parameter.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 6; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: pair-swap
cases.intent: Two type parameters permuted by swap; fst drops the other affine field.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 6; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: opt-default
cases.intent: A Maybe-like option; or_else drops the default when a value is present.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 6; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: seq-parity
cases.intent: A List-like family walked by structural recursion under an erased type parameter.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 6; every call must match the seed. Blocked until increment 1 (recursion) is available.

cases.name: quantity-parity
cases.intent: One Kind(a) walk instantiated at &2 over Data and at &1 over a Type family; compact <&2,Flag> spelling.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 6; every call must match the seed. Blocked until increment 1 (recursion) is available.

cases.name: quantity-meet
cases.intent: Kind(a <&> b) at &2 and &2 is Data, so a + binder reuses the pair.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 6; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: quantity-short-form
cases.intent: Seq<Flag> is Seq<&1, Flag> and +Seq<Flag> is Seq<&2, Flag>, which a + binder may reuse.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 6; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: reusable-generic
cases.intent: A + binder at an erased Data type is copied into both fields of a pair.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 6; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: data-cell
cases.intent: A Data family over a Data parameter is Data; a + binder reads it twice.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 6; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: erased-value-arg
cases.intent: An erased value argument is checked, not run; two erased uses and one live use of c are allowed.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 6; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: generic-let
cases.intent: A local binding annotated with an applied generic type, Box<Flag>.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 6; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: shadow-type-name
cases.intent: A type parameter named Flag shadows the datatype Flag; pick runs at Color.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 6; every call must match the seed. Type names resolve to binders, not display names.

cases.name: quantity-zero
cases.intent: The seed accepts a Data element type at Kind(&0) when abstract code uses the element once.

knot.justification: Seed-valid (D7 fixes the seed as reference): Knot must not reject &0 instantiation as Invalid.

cases.name: quantity-data-fits-type
cases.intent: Data fits Kind(&1): a Data element type instantiates an affine quantity.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 6; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: forward-generic-types
cases.intent: Families named before their declaration: a plain family in short form, a Kind(a) family fully spelled.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 6; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: phantom-type
cases.intent: Tagged<A> stores no A; retag changes only the erased type index.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 6; every call must match the seed.

cases.name: erased-interleaved
cases.intent: Erased parameters between live ones; only live positions carry values.

knot.justification: Seed-valid program inside increment 6; every call must match the seed. Host ordinals are the live arguments only; erased positions are omitted.

cases.name: closure-apply
cases.intent: A generic higher-order apply over a top-level function value.

knot.justification: Seed-valid, but function values are closures (increment 7); the first unsupported form is the arrow type in the parameter list of apply, which tests/compiler-structural/function-field already pins as parameter-type.

cases.name: template-twice
cases.intent: A ~ template parameter applied twice.

knot.justification: Seed-valid, but templates belong to S3; the first unsupported form is the ~ binder in the parameter list of twice. Code reconciled by the coordinator to the classify increment's template-binder (src/parse.bend template_parameter, tests/subsets/classification-cases.json); the originally proposed 'template' prefix could never match.

cases.name: match-erased-type
cases.intent: A match on an erased type parameter whose only arm is a variable binds and inspects nothing.

knot.justification: Seed-valid, so erased-scrutinee is not a valid reason; variable patterns are increment 3, so Unsupported is allowed and Invalid is not (D4).

cases.name: alias-type
cases.intent: A type-returning definition used as a parameter type: Wrap(Flag) unfolds to Box<Flag>.

knot.justification: Seed-valid type-level computation; increment 6 may defer it as Unsupported but may never report it Invalid (D4).

cases.name: affine-dup-type
cases.intent: An affine value of an erased Type is copied into both fields.
seed_reason:
- observed : x (consumed more than once)
Location: dup

knot.justification: The seed rejects the second use of affine x; the enum profile already names this affine-reuse.

cases.name: affine-dup-data
cases.intent: -A: Data alone does not make x reusable; only a + binder does.
seed_reason:
- observed : x (consumed more than once)
Location: dup

knot.justification: Data licenses copies only through a + binder; an unmarked x stays affine even at a Data type.

cases.name: reusable-type-param
cases.intent: A + binder whose type is an erased parameter of kind Type.
seed_reason:
- expected : Data
- observed : Type
Location: dup

knot.justification: A + binder requires a Data type; reusable-type is the existing code for a reusable parameter whose type is not Data.

cases.name: reusable-kind-var
cases.intent: A + binder at Kind(a): the quantity a is not known to be &2.
seed_reason:
- expected : Data
- observed : Kind(a)
Location: keep

knot.justification: Kind(a) is not known to be Data, so the + binder has a non-Data type (reusable-type), whatever a callee later passes.

cases.name: meet-not-reusable
cases.intent: Kind(&2 <&> &1) is Kind(&1) = Type, so +p is rejected.
seed_reason:
- expected : Data
- observed : Type
Location: both

knot.justification: The quantity meet of &2 and &1 is &1, so the pair type is Type and a + binder on it is reusable-type.

cases.name: erased-value-live
cases.intent: An erased value of generic type is returned live.

knot.justification: The seed rejects live use of the erased binder w; the enum profile already names this erased-live.

cases.name: erased-type-live
cases.intent: An erased type argument is passed to a live Type parameter at runtime.

knot.justification: The seed rejects the erased A in a live argument position. A live Type parameter may itself be outside increment 6, so Invalid or Unsupported both qualify; Checked never does.

cases.name: erased-scrutinee
cases.intent: An erased generic box is inspected by a live match.
seed_reason:
a live scrutinee (a - scrutinee matches only in a dead region)
Location: peek

knot.justification: The seed rejects a live match on an erased binder; the enum profile already names this erased-scrutinee.

cases.name: rigid-mismatch
cases.intent: Distinct type parameters are rigid: a value of A is not a value of B.
seed_reason:
- expected : B
- observed : A
Location: coerce

knot.justification: The seed compares the rigid variables A and B and rejects the return; that is a type mismatch.

cases.name: wrong-type-arg
cases.intent: The explicit type argument Color disagrees with the Flag in the box.
seed_reason:
- expected : Color
- observed : Flag
Location: main

knot.justification: Instantiating at Color makes the box field expect Color; On{} is a Flag, a type mismatch.

cases.name: ghost-bad
cases.intent: An erased argument is still type-checked: On{} is not a Color.
seed_reason:
- expected : Color
- observed : Flag
Location: main

knot.justification: Erased arguments are checked but not run; the erased w expects Color and receives a Flag.

cases.name: phantom-mismatch
cases.intent: Tagged<Flag> is not Tagged<Color>, although both have the same runtime layout.
seed_reason:
- expected : Tagged<Color>
- observed : Tagged<Flag>
Location: cross

knot.justification: Type indices are compared even when erased from the representation; a uniform boxed layout must not identify them.

cases.name: quantity-invariant
cases.intent: Seq<&2, Flag> does not fit Seq<&1, Flag>: datatype quantity arguments are invariant.
seed_reason:
- expected : Seq<&1, Flag>
- observed : Seq<&2, Flag>
Location: main

knot.justification: The seed compares quantity arguments of a family by equality; there is no &2-to-&1 subsumption for Seq.

cases.name: kind-type-for-data
cases.intent: A Type element (Box<Flag>) does not fit Kind(&2).
seed_reason:
- expected : Data
- observed : Type
head_or(&2, Box<Flag>,
Location: main

knot.justification: Kind(a) instantiation is increment 6, so Knot must report Invalid; no existing code names a kind-argument mismatch, so the code is open.

cases.name: type-arity
cases.intent: A one-parameter family applied to two type arguments.
seed_reason:
- expected : Box with 1 parameter
Location: open

knot.justification: Type application arity is increment 6, so Knot must report Invalid; no existing code names it, so the code is open.

cases.name: data-holds-type
cases.intent: A Data family with a field of a Type parameter.
seed_reason:
- expected : Data
- observed : Type
Location: Cell

knot.justification: A Data declaration may hold only Data fields; the structural checkpoint already names this data-field-kind.

cases.name: forward-short-form
cases.intent: A forward Kind(a) family written in short form.
seed_reason:
- expected : Wide with 2 parameters
Location: early

knot.justification: A family named before its declaration must spell every parameter; this is an increment 6 rule, so Invalid, with the code open.

cases.name: alias-misuse
cases.intent: A + binder behind an alias that unfolds to a Type family.
seed_reason:
- expected : Data
- observed : Type
Location: keep

knot.justification: Generic misuse hidden behind an alias (an S2 exit gate). Increment 6 may report the type-level definition Unsupported, but must never check the program.
